work_description:

===========================
Ensure compliance with safety procedures according to the company policy and requirements.

===================
Manual Name: 8M-3 INSTRUCTION MANAUL FOR PURIFIER;5303.pdf
Pdf Page No: 56
Chapter: 3. Maintenance Inspection Procedures
Section: 3.1 Routine checks

DESCRIPTION
===========
Routine Checks :
1. Check the feed rate with respect to set feed rate for any changes.
2. Check the temperature with set temperature level.
3. Check the pressure of light liquid outlet is to be coincide roughly with the set pressure of the leakage.
4. Check for any increase in vibration.
5. Check for operational noise in gear pump and bearing etc. 
6. Check the rated current on daily basis.
7. Check the gear pump oil quantity. 
8. Check the safety joint of gears for any deformation.
9. Check for oil leakage in pipe joints.
10. Check & adjust pressure LED (yellow) lit or flashing for Leakage Monitor.
11. Check indicate revolution LED (green) is flashing for Discharge Monitor.
remarks: Minor adjustments made. Equipment performance within acceptable parameters.

work_description:
SAFETY PROCEDURE (COMPANY)
===========================
Ensure compliance with safety procedures according to the company policy and requirements.

DESCRIPTION
===========
1. Liner Condition (Visual / Indirect)

Check for abnormal scavenge space condition (if accessible).

Look for signs of scuffing, scoring, or polishing (based on inspection ports or trend data).

Monitor liner condition through performance parameters if direct access is not possible.

2. Lubrication

Verify cylinder lubrication rate (if applicable) is as per maker’s recommendation.

Check lube oil distribution and absence of oil starvation signs.

Review lube oil consumption trends.

3. Cooling & Sealing

Monitor jacket water temperature and pressure related to cylinder No.01.

Check for cooling water leakage into cylinder or crankcase.

Verify condition of liner sealing arrangements (indirect observation).
remarks: Checks completed as per manufacturer guidelines for AE Cylinder Liner Inspection - 1M. Next service due as scheduled.

job_title: Main Engine General Inspection - 1M
work_description:
SAFETY PROCEDURE (COMPANY)
===========================
Ensure compliance with safety procedures according to the company policy and requirements.

DESCRIPTION
===========
Carry out a complete monthly inspection of the main diesel engine to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation. The inspection includes mechanical, lubrication, cooling, fuel, air, exhaust, control, and safety systems, with emphasis on early detection of wear, leakage, abnormal vibration, or deviation from normal operating parameters.

1. General Condition

Inspect engine exterior for oil, fuel, water, or exhaust gas leakage.

Check for abnormal vibration, noise, or overheating.

Ensure foundation bolts, holding-down bolts, and chocks show no abnormal condition.

2. Lubrication System

Check sump oil level and condition.

Review lube oil pressure, temperature, and differential pressure across filters.

Inspect lube oil filters and coolers for leakage.

Verify oil mist detector operation and alarm status.

3. Fuel System

Inspect fuel pumps, injectors, and fuel lines for leakage.

Check fuel oil pressure, temperature, and viscosity (as applicable).

Drain and check fuel filters and settling system as required.

4. Cooling Water System

Check jacket water pressure, temperature, and expansion tank level.

Inspect freshwater and seawater pumps for leakage.

Verify cooler condition and seawater inlet/outlet temperatures.

5. Air & Exhaust System

Inspect turbocharger casing, air inlet filters, and ducting.

Check exhaust manifold for leakage, cracks, or insulation damage.

Monitor exhaust gas temperatures for cylinder deviation.

6. Starting & Control System

Check starting air pressure and drain receivers.

Inspect starting valves and control air system.

Verify correct operation of engine control system, telegraph, and safety interlocks.

7. Safety & Protection Devices

Test safety devices as per PMS schedule:

Overspeed trip

Low lube oil pressure alarm

High jacket water temperature alarm

Verify crankcase relief valves condition.

8. Performance Monitoring

Record engine RPM, load, and fuel consumption.

Review trends for lube oil consumption and exhaust temperatures.

Compare readings with previous records.
remarks: All checks completed as per manufacturer guidelines. Next service due as scheduled.
